thread.title: Index Funds: Nasdaq Leads As Apple, FANG Stocks Rebound

author: NANCY GONDO
title: Index Funds: Nasdaq Leads As Apple, FANG Stocks Rebound

organizations.name: spdr s&p oil & gas exploration & production

text:
Growth stocks recovered some of their losses Tuesday after a major drubbing in the prior session. The tech-heavy Invesco QQQ Trust ( QQQ ) led the major index funds.
X The FANG stocks bounced back, though they haven't regained all their Monday losses. Facebook ( FB ) advanced 0.6%, Amazon ( AMZN ) 2% and Leaderboard name Netflix ( NFLX ) 5%. Alphabet ( GOOGL ) was slightly positive.
Apple ( AAPL ) staged a big rebound, rising 2% to recover Monday's losses and then some after finding support at its 50-day moving average. Volume was a bit soft, though. RBC Capital in a Sunday report said the iPhone maker's music and video offerings could become a "meaningful" driver of sales and earnings in the next few years.
Energy led the upside among sector funds as West Texas intermediate crude oil prices surged more than 3% to $70.26 a barrel. SPDR S&P Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ( XOP ) rose 2.2%, iShares U.S. Energy ( IYE ) advanced 1.6% and Energy Select Sector SPDR ( XLE ) added 1.4%.
